recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; changing the parameter to a literal composite would conflict with the applied source and later clarifications that intentionally preserve the single special Location-near parameter.
issue_request: FHIR-14216 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request saying near-distance was not useful without a location and should be merged with Location near searching so chained searches could keep the distance matched to the location.
initial_application: The historical source change was committed as GF#14216 in 1d2f0c3e02b3ad1f21c8b3c4d8b88bce34fe9587, which replaced the STU3 near plus near-distance query example with a single near parameter carrying latitude, longitude, distance, and unit components, and documented that the new format supports multiples and chaining.
additional_context: Zulip discussion shows editors considered a composite representation but settled on a manually coded special single parameter because the distance is relative to the submitted point. Later PA issues FHIR-22749, FHIR-27157, and FHIR-33976 clarified the same Location-near parameter without reintroducing near-distance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Location is active in source/fhir.ini, current Location-near is a special SearchParameter with [latitude]|[longitude]|[distance]|[units] syntax, and the Location notes still explain that near-distance was deprecated by this format.
